title: iPhone free for 13 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 13 min (since 22:54Z; released by iphone-runner). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: phone-queue (owner iphone-runner; its note names the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of iphone-runner takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
Steward (mgmt-devices): nudge iphone-runner by message (SendMessage) and answer the user here; the lead is the second tier (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
